capabilities: Show click hints to activate links, buttons, and tabs
Bind reading-mode keys to commands or terminal commands
Provide leader-key sequences with a which-key popup
Add surround, multi-cursor, and table navigation to Vim editing
Drive the file explorer and Web viewer pages from the keyboard
disambiguation: Not the Vimium browser extension or the existing Vimium community plugin; it is an independent keyboard layer for Obsidian.
extras: Forces Reading view and enables Obsidian's native Vim key bindings while active, restoring both on disable. Web viewer support injects a script into each page; hints cover the top frame only and some pages refuse injection. File-explorer deletes are undoable from an in-memory snapshot (up to 50 operations / 50 MB).
intentEvidence: this is an independent reimplementation of the Vimium idea for Obsidian
problem: Obsidian's default mouse-driven interface and its native Vim mode lack Vimium-style click hints, leader-key menus, and table or file-explorer keyboard navigation.

relations.evidence: A Vimium-FF–style keyboard layer for Obsidian.
Not affiliated with the Vimium browser extension or the existing Vimium community plugin
If you use the Folder Notes plugin, folder-note files that it hides from the explorer are skipped

summary: Keyboard layer that adds Vimium-style click hints, leader-key menus, and Vim editing enhancements to Obsidian.
